one_line: A real child's reaction, a specific family moment as the reason, and one comment word shown on screen.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 static wide: a woman and a girl (about 7 to 8) on a play mat; the girl pulls a book from a paper envelope. Voice (transcript): "דמיינו ספר אישי לילד שלכם שבו הוא הגיבור הראשי". Word subtitles from 0:01.
q1_hook.why: A real unwrapping and a one-sentence premise, said and written word by word, make the idea clear by 3.4 s (H1, H6, H2). Faces are on screen from frame one (K8). But the shot is wide, so the book is small until 0:04, and the first word is still fading in (F4, T3).

beats.what: Static wide: a woman and a girl on a mat; the girl pulls a book from an envelope
beats.why: A real unwrapping, with the premise word by word

beats.what: The girl smiles and holds the FunSome cover to the camera
beats.why: Brand and a happy face in one frame

beats.what: Close-up of the open book, the girl's hand and face; "אתם יכולים", "ההרפתקה", "המסר"
beats.why: Child and pages together while choices are explained

beats.what: Top-down page flips: a girl on cushions, a mother hugging a child; "וזה הרבה יותר מסתם ספר"
beats.why: Shows the emotional tone of the pages

beats.what: The girl lies reading, smiling, her hand on the page; "זו דרך מיוחדת לתת מקום לרגשות שלו"
A page with a boy on a sofa, then the cover; "כשאח שלו הקטן", "קנאה"
beats.why: The sibling situation gives a concrete reason

beats.what: Wide: the girl and a baby on the mat; a close-up of the open book; "רגשות"
beats.why: The book as a way to handle feelings

beats.what: Cover close-up; "זה לא עוד סיפור"; from 0:39 a box: "כתבו לי \"ספר\" בתגובות"
beats.why: A single ask after the feeling

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen from 0:39 and in the caption: write the word "ספר" in the comments and she sends details. A rhetorical "רוצים לשמוע עוד על הספרים האישיים?".
q2_flow.why: A new picture every 3 to 4 s with a real child reading keeps it moving (R3, K8). The sibling story, a new brother, jealousy, a book that helps, is a real arc, though the pictures do not show it (K2). The ask arrives only after the emotional close (R4).

q3_cta.what: On screen at 0:39 to 0:42 and in the caption: "רוצים לשמוע עוד על הספרים האישיים של FunSome? כתבו לי \"ספר\" בתגובות ואשלח לכם פרטים". Not said in the voice.
q3_cta.why: One action, a generic word for details by DM, shown after the story and repeated in the caption (C1, C3, C6). The box sits mid-frame, inside the safe zone. But it is not said aloud, and what it delivers, "פרטים", is vague (C6, R6).

q4_shown.what: A girl unwrapping and holding up the book, 0:00-0:06; reading it, hand on the page; flips of a girl on cushions, a mother hugging a child; the cover with a laughing illustrated girl, 0:24-0:42; a girl and a baby on the mat. No price.
q4_shown.why: A real child's smile and hand on the page are first-hand reaction proof (S6), and the book is out by 0:03 (S1). The illustrated girl is curly-haired like the girl on camera, but no photo sits beside it (S2). Choosing the adventure is said, not shown (S8). Faces with a name go against S5.

q5_edit.what: 12 shots in 42.8 s, about 3.6 s each; hard cuts from a static wide to handheld close-ups. No speed changes seen. Word-by-word white subtitles, some words enlarged. Ends on the cover held 8 s, the ask box in the last 3 s.
q5_edit.why: A real movement in the first seconds and a cut at 3.9 s (E1), then a moderate pace with cuts on voice phrases (E2). Word-by-word captions are synced to the voice (E4). The 8 s hold on the final cover carries the emotion and the ask (R1).

q6_topic.what: A sibling story: a book about becoming a "sandwich child" when a little brother is born, to help with jealousy and sadness. It serves parents of an older child.
q6_topic.why: A new sibling is a real concern, and naming jealousy and sadness makes parents feel understood (K6). It is also a buying moment (K7). "Giving space to feelings" is a modest claim (K4), told as a story (K2).

q7_filmed.what: A static wide shot of a woman and a girl on a play mat before a bookshelf; handheld close-ups of the book and the girl's face; a top-down page flip; a static wide shot of the girl and a baby; a cover close-up. Daylight.
q7_filmed.why: A real home and daylight look native (H8, F7). Top-down hands put the viewer in the reader's seat (F5), and the last cover shot fills the frame (F4). Faces carry the feeling (K8).

q8_text.on_screen: White word-by-word subtitles, no box, centred about 79% down, key words enlarged: "נכתבת" (0:05), "ההרפתקה" (0:09), "המסר" (0:10), "קנאה" (0:26), "ועצב" (0:27), "אישית" (0:36), small ones like "שלכם שבו הוא" (0:02) and "זה לא עוד סיפור" (0:35). A mid-frame box at 0:39: "רוצים לשמוע עוד על הספרים האישיים של FunSome?" and the comment-word ask.
q8_text.caption: "החיוך הזה שווה הכול." Four short lines, about 35 words: the smile, a line on a child as the story's hero, "רוצים לשמוע עוד על הספרים האישיים של FunSome?", and the comment-word ask. No hashtags, no disclosure word.
q8_text.why: One word at a time, synced and sometimes big, works muted and stays short (T1, T2). The subtitles sit in the bottom 35%, while the ask box is mid-frame (T4, F2). The caption names the brand and "ספרים אישיים" but opens on a feeling (T7). No disclosure word anywhere (T8).

weak_points: A scripted voiceover that does not match the pictures; the keyword promises only "details"; no disclosure word; the child's name on the cover beside her face; soft-focus close-ups.
lumebook_takeaway: Film the child-free parts: the envelope, the cover and page flips, with word-by-word captions; end with one comment word on screen that delivers a real offer.
not_verified: Whether the woman is the account owner; who the girl and the baby are; whether the voice is the creator's; the voice says "he" while the child on camera is a girl, so the story may be a generic script; whether music plays. The first caption word at 0:00 is too faint to read. The transcript spells the brand "פנסום", so burned-in text is quoted. The child's name is in the cover title and the transcript, not quoted.
